brief_title: Home Visits and Telephone-Supported Education for Adults With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Effects of Home Visits and Telephone-Supported Educational Interventions on Diabetes Knowledge, Self-Care Behaviors, and Diabetes-Related Difficulties in Individuals With Type 2 Diabetes Attending a Family Health Center

arm_groups.label: Home Visit-Based Education
intervention_names: Behavioral: Nurse-Led Home Visit-Based Diabetes Education

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in Diabetes Health-Promoting Self-Care Behaviors
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Baseline (before education), immediately after the 4-week education period, and 1 month after completion of education.

brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate the effects of home visits and telephone-supported education on diabetes knowledge, self-care behaviors, and diabetes-related difficulties in adults with type 2 diabetes attending a family health center in Türkiye. The study will examine whether these educational approaches help participants better understand their diabetes, manage daily self-care, and cope with difficulties related to living with diabetes.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Aged 18-65 years. Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus for at least 6 months. Able to read and understand Turkish. No health condition that impairs cognition or communication. Owns a smartphone. Uses insulin, oral antidiabetic medication, or both. Willing to participate in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

Pregnancy. Inability to complete the data collection instruments due to a cognitive or psychiatric condition.

Unwillingness to participate in the study.
